descriptive_controller_statistics.pulse_boundary_scope: Pulse decisions at consumer4.000 through4.079s affect completed4.001 through4.080s. The diagnostic contact samples at each consumer tick describe the preceding completed interval. Fixed windows are selected by consumer tick, not outcomes.
descriptive_controller_statistics.count_definitions: A slot is one joint at one decision. A clamped decision has at least one flagged joint. Position flags describe requested target clipping to authored bounds; slew flags describe target-rate clipping. They do not measure actuator torque saturation or realized joint speed.
descriptive_controller_statistics.peak_definitions: Absolute maximum bounded correction, with signed value and first consumer tick attaining it. This alone does not establish an unbounded request was clipped.
descriptive_controller_statistics.interpretation: Caps also occur in successful cases. These single-seed descriptive counts do not identify a cause of falling, establish hardware reliability, or change the recovery predicate; they can inform a separate future predeclared controller experiment.
descriptive_controller_statistics.compact_statistics_note: Per-joint counts are omitted only from this compact copy. Aggregate counts, first clamp ticks and signed correction peaks remain for every case and fixed window. The SHA-bound external statistics retain per-joint data.
